case_module.claim: Recording a delivered item in the ledger is independent of how the item reached `delivered` -- of which other items are in the inbox, accepted, or queued. The Given asserts one pre-state (i1 delivered, i2 still in the inbox) instead of enumerating every reachable configuration that has a delivered item. What it claims is irrelevant to Record: upstream ingest state. If Record ever reads inbox, accepted, or queue, the claim is false and this Given must go.
case_module.name: Scenario_RecordAfterDelivery
